title: Product, platform and identity development
definition: Product, software, web and identity development for a professional-audio ecosystem spanning instruments, effects, sound libraries and creator tools.
roleSummary: Defined the product family, developed its public website and visual system, planned the software and service architecture, and produced the initial digital product assets.

highlights.title: Connected product family
highlights.description: Software instruments, effects, routing tools, sound libraries and creator services are organised as one coherent product system.

highlights.title: Public digital experience
highlights.description: Responsive web architecture presents the wider product family, supporting services and documentation through one clear interface.

highlights.title: Signal-led visual language
highlights.description: A continuous route-and-transformation grammar connects the identity, interfaces, diagrams and product assets.

title: Complex place data made immediate
definition: A data-driven platform for comparing population density, infrastructure, transport and place relationships through clear visual interfaces.
roleSummary: Developed the product concept, data model, comparison logic, visual language, website and application direction.
highlightTitle: From source context to clear comparison

highlights.title: Density translation
highlights.description: Population and spatial information is converted into visual forms that can be understood and compared quickly.

highlights.title: Explore and compare
highlights.description: Dedicated application views support place discovery, side-by-side comparison and deeper inspection.

highlights.title: Source-aware data foundations
highlights.description: Data keeps its geography, time period and source context while moving through the comparison system.

title: Personalised guide and publication development
definition: Product and application development for a personalised annual guide delivered across physical and digital formats.
roleSummary: Developed the product architecture, publication model, responsive application experience, account journeys and connected delivery workflow.
highlightTitle: The publication product and its digital delivery system

highlights.title: Annual publication architecture
highlights.description: The personalised 365-day physical Guide is the organising product, generated from a canonical annual dataset and publication workflow.

highlights.title: Public website and ordering journey
highlights.description: The public website explains the product, establishes the annual Guide proposition and provides the route into ordering and account creation.

highlights.title: Connected application experience
highlights.description: The evolving application carries personal context, guide access and supporting digital experiences without replacing the printed Guide.

heroImage.caption: Visionary Guide public website and product proposition

mediaSections.title: The evolving personalised guide application
mediaSections.description: The application is the deeper interactive layer: resolving personal context, celestial state, guide generation and results into a responsive experience. It remains ongoing development and supports the annual publication rather than becoming the main product image.

title: Catalogue, storefront and brand experience
definition: Commerce architecture, catalogue modelling, responsive storefront development and brand presentation for Community Supplies.
roleSummary: Developed the catalogue structure, storefront, responsive interface, visual language and independent deployment foundation.
highlightTitle: Catalogue structure carried into the interface

highlights.title: Modular catalogue
highlights.description: Products, ranges and brand relationships are organised independently from the page layout.

highlights.title: Shop and marketplace interfaces
highlights.description: The public experience supports direct product discovery and broader marketplace presentation.

highlights.title: Distinct visual language
highlights.description: Colour, typography and product imagery give the storefront its own recognisable digital character.

galleryTitle: A commerce experience across key views

title: Saving, sharing and personal collections
definition: A social platform for saving, sharing and building personal collections around the things people love.
roleSummary: Developed the product concept, public SaveSites, personal My Saves experience, responsive interface and coded identity system.
highlightTitle: Public collections, personal cabinets and coded identity

highlights.title: SaveSites
highlights.description: Public collection spaces bring films, music, images, ideas and shared interests together around a person or theme.

highlights.title: My Saves
highlights.description: A personal cabinet gives each user a clear place to keep and organise the things they care about.

highlights.title: Coded identity
highlights.description: The original identity translated the SaveOurs name and SOS cadence into a recognisable signal system before the later visual redesign.

mediaSections.title: An SOS rhythm translated through a Morse-code motif
mediaSections.description: The original design mission was to encode SaveOurs as a repeating signal language. The SOS cadence, barcode-like lines and circular marks formed the first logo system before the identity was revisited and developed into its later form.

title: One identity across a growing product family
definition: Product, identity and digital presentation work spanning food, drinks, packaging concepts and a public web experience.
roleSummary: Developed the core identity, product-family treatments, visual assets and website presentation.

highlights.title: Flexible core identity
highlights.description: A recognisable central mark supports distinct treatments across the wider product range.

highlights.title: Category applications
highlights.description: Packaging and product mock-ups can take on their own flavour and colour while remaining visibly part of MiCKz.

highlights.title: Digital presentation
highlights.description: Product assets and the public website bring the identity family together in one consumer-facing experience.

identityTitle: A flexible mark for a growing product family

mediaSections.title: Applying the identity across product categories
mediaSections.description: Selected packaging concepts and mock-up designs show how the central identity can flex across different products without treating any one item as the defining or privileged product.

title: Stories, ideas and worlds for a mixed-age audience
definition: A mixed-age speculative and philosophical publishing world spanning mature fiction, accessible stories, serial work and a dedicated children's section.
roleSummary: Developed the parent publishing structure, story-world framing, audience routes, editorial organisation and public website direction.
highlightTitle: One story world with several reading routes

highlights.title: Story-world architecture
highlights.description: Stories, recurring ideas and publication families sit inside one coherent imaginative world.

highlights.title: Mixed-age navigation
highlights.description: Readers can move through mature, general, accessible and children's work through clear dedicated routes.

highlights.title: Public reading experience
highlights.description: The website direction gives the wider writing practice room to grow across formats and audiences.
